defect_found: Dr.Jit 0.4.6 PCG32(size, initstate, initseq) adds arange(size) to initseq internally. data81.ref_eval passed initseq = arange(size) + offset, i.e. sequence 2 j + offset, so launch chunks of one call overlapped (chunk k lane j and chunk k-1 lane j + size/2 drew identical random streams): different (pair, walk) lanes in different chunks were perfectly correlated. Means stay unbiased; errors of different pairs were correlated. Affected only the aborted A1 data of runs 1 and 2 (never used). Single-call uses elsewhere (refaudit, contract G81 with per-call initstate, bench, render validation) have unique sequences 2 j and are unaffected; contract81's report-only sampling utility reused one initstate for its three lightings and now offsets it per lighting.

changes.streams: data81.ref_eval: initseq = scalar global offset (pair0 x nwalk + chunk offset) -> sequence = global lane index, unique across chunks, calls of one purpose and shards
